feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 May 2026 8:48am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 28 May 2026 at 8:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is centred in the North Sea.


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, decreasing 3 or 4 this afternoon, veering south or southwest 4 to 6 late afternoon or early evening. Decreasing 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming mainly moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then the risk of some coastal mist and fog patches developing from the south later this afternoon and evening.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor in mist or any fog patches this afternoon & evening.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5 decreasing 3 or 4 during Friday afternoon, then backing south or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate falling slight on Friday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
